_readme: Single source of truth for the marketing website. Edit, then run `node scripts/sync.mjs` to update every page. email is the vendor address shown in the footer and used as the demo form's mailto fallback; leave it blank until the owner supplies it (never an example.com address). phone/phoneE164 are optional and hide every tel link when blank. siteUrl is the canonical address (canonical, og:url, sitemap, JSON-LD). basePath is the folder the site is served from (scripts/pages.mjs requires it to match the build base). appPath and signInPath are the staff app, linked relatively from every page. formEndpoint is an optional fallback for the demo form. shopInbox: demo requests post here (the key is the public anon key). _placeholders lists values that must be supplied before launch; check.mjs warns while it is non-empty and fails with --release.
name: WPI Driveline Shop Management System
description: Shop management software for independent auto repair shops: check-in, inspections, approvals, workflow, parts, payments, reports and QuickBooks sync. Works offline.
